blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY — The police arrested three drug suspects and seized and estimated P439,892 worth of shabu in a buy-bust operation in Barangay Kenram, Isulan, Sultan Kudarat, on Friday. The Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) Region 12, through its Sultan Kudarat Provincial Office, led the operation at Purok Pagkakaisa with support from the Isulan Municipal Police Station and the Sultan Kudarat Provincial Police Office’s Provincial Drug Enforcement Unit. Arrested were three individuals identified only by their aliases as Rika, 29; Jed, 29; and Anthony, 37. Authorities seized three heat-sealed transparent plastic sachets containing suspected shabu.
